# Support more resume PDF layouts without freezing local intake

## What & Why
Resume intake currently handles the attached text-layer Flate PDF shape and fails closed for scanned or unsupported documents. A bounded parser expansion would improve compatibility without weakening the local-only privacy boundary.

## Done looks like
- Keep decompression time-bounded and skip font streams
- Add support for additional text operators and common uncompressed text layers
- Surface a clear unsupported-document explanation when extraction is incomplete
- Add representative local-only tests without committing personal resume values
